variations.name: Calf Stretch (wall)
instructions: Face a wall, hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back, heel flat, back leg straight.
Lean the hips toward the wall until you feel a stretch in the back-leg calf.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
instructions: Kneel on one knee, other foot flat in front (mat under the knee).
Tuck the pelvis under and shift forward slightly.
Feel the stretch at the front of the back-leg hip; keep the ribs down.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Hamstring Stretch (seated)
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs straight ahead (a little knee bend is fine).
Hinge forward from the hips with a long back.
Reach toward your shins until you feel a stretch behind the thighs.
Breathe slowly; do not bounce.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Child's Pose / Cat-Cow
instructions: Start on hands and knees.
Sit the hips back toward the heels and reach the arms forward (child's pose).
Breathe into the back; optionally alternate round and arch (cat-cow).
Stay relaxed; no forcing.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Chest Stretch (doorway / wall)
instructions: Place one forearm on a wall or door frame, elbow at about shoulder height.
Turn the body gently away from the wall.
Feel the stretch across the chest and front of the shoulder.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Shoulder Stretch (cross-body)
instructions: Bring one arm across the chest.
Use the other forearm to hold it close, shoulders relaxed.
Feel the stretch in the back of the shoulder.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Ankle Mobility (knee-to-wall)
instructions: Stand facing a wall, one foot a hand-width back from it.
Bend the front knee toward the wall, heel flat.
Move slowly in and out within a pain-free range.
Switch sides.
cautions: Stretch gently; mild tension is normal, pain is not. Stop if you feel sharp or pinching pain.

variations.name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Hands on a wall or a stable raised surface, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest toward the surface, elbows about 45° from the body.
Press back up to straight arms without sagging the hips.
Count only full-range reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Kneel on a mat, hands under the shoulders, body straight from head to knees.
Lower the chest toward the floor, elbows about 45°.
Press up to straight arms; keep the hips in line.
Count only full-range reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Standard Push-Up
instructions: Plank position, hands slightly wider than the shoulders.
Lower the chest to just above the floor, elbows about 45°.
Press up to full lockout with a straight body.
Count only full-range reps.
formCues: Brace the core and squeeze the glutes
Chest to just above the floor
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Band Row (seated)
instructions: Sit on the floor, legs forward, band anchored securely in front of you at hand height.
Pull the handles toward the lower ribs, elbows close to the body.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
Keep the back long, no leaning back.
formCues: Pull elbows back, not shoulders up
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place a knee or foot in it.
Hang with straight arms, shoulders pulled away from the ears.
Pull until the chin clears the bar, then lower slowly with control.
Use the lightest band that still allows clean reps.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check that the bar and band are secure before every set.

variations.name: Air Squat
instructions: Feet about shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Sit the hips back and down until thighs are about parallel (or as deep as comfortable).
Keep the heels down and the chest up.
Stand tall and squeeze the glutes at the top.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Split Squat (per side)
instructions: Step one foot forward, the other back, feet hip-width apart.
Lower the back knee toward the floor, front knee over the mid-foot.
Push through the front foot to stand. Finish all reps, then switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart.
Press through the heels and lift the hips until the body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze the glutes for a moment at the top, then lower slowly.
formCues: Ribs down, no arching the lower back
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor, neck neutral.
Hold, breathing steadily, then lower with control.
formCues: Look at the floor, long neck
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Controlled Kettlebell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, kettlebell between the feet.
Push the hips back with a flat back and grip the handle.
Drive through the feet to stand tall; do not swing the weight.
Lower with control back to the floor.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Controlled tempo only; no ballistic or swinging work.

variations.name: Front Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders.
Body in one straight line; squeeze the glutes and brace the core.
Hold without letting the hips sag or pike.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Side Plank (per side)
instructions: Lie on one side, forearm under the shoulder, legs stacked (or feet staggered).
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, hips and knees at 90°.
Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly toward the floor, lower back flat.
Return and alternate sides. One rep = both sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
instructions: Feet on a stable chair or step, hands on the floor, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from the body.
Press to straight arms without sagging the hips.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Diamond Push-Up
instructions: Plank position, hands together under the chest, thumbs and index fingers forming a diamond.
Lower the chest to the hands, elbows close to the body.
Press to full lockout.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Archer Push-Up (per side)
instructions: Wide hand position, hands turned slightly out.
Lower toward one hand while the other arm stays straight.
Press back up, alternate sides. Count each side.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: One-Arm Push-Up Negative (per side)
instructions: Feet wide, one hand under the chest, other hand behind the back.
Lower slowly for about 4 seconds to just above the floor.
Reset with both hands; repeat, then switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Stop if the wrist or elbow hurts.

variations.name: One-Arm Push-Up (per side)
instructions: Feet wide, one hand under the chest, other hand behind the back.
Lower with the body square to the floor.
Press up; finish a side, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Hips high, body in an upside-down V, hands shoulder-width.
Bend the elbows and lower the top of the head toward the floor.
Press back to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Elevated Pike Push-Up
instructions: Feet on a stable chair or step, hips high, hands shoulder-width.
Lower the head between the hands.
Press up to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Wall Handstand Hold (chest to wall)
instructions: Walk the feet up a wall from plank until the chest faces the wall.
Arms straight, shoulders pushed up toward the ears.
Hold with a tight body; walk back down to leave.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Inverted work: clear the space, build up gradually, stop if dizzy.

variations.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up Negative
instructions: Kick up to a wall handstand, belly to the wall.
Lower slowly (about 4 seconds) until the head touches a folded mat.
Come down safely and repeat.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Inverted work: use a mat under the head.

variations.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
instructions: Wall handstand, belly to the wall, hands shoulder-width.
Lower the head to a folded mat.
Press back to full lockout.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Inverted work: use a mat under the head.

variations.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar, hands just wider than the shoulders.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower under control to straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
instructions: Hang, then pull explosively but controlled so the chest reaches the bar.
Lean back slightly at the top.
Lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Bar Muscle-Up
instructions: False grip or strong overgrip, pull the bar to the lower chest.
Transition the elbows over the bar quickly.
Press to straight arms on top, then lower with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Check the bar is secure; skill work, consider coaching.

variations.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (per side)
instructions: Back foot on a stable chair behind you, front foot a stride ahead.
Lower until the front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up through the front heel; finish a side, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Shrimp Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg, hold the other foot behind you.
Lower until the back knee touches the floor lightly.
Stand back up on the working leg.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Assisted Pistol Squat (per side)
instructions: Hold a door frame or post lightly for balance.
Lower on one leg with the other leg straight out in front.
Stand up using as little help as possible.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Pistol Squat (per side)
instructions: Stand on one leg, other leg straight in front.
Lower to full depth with the heel down.
Stand up with control; switch sides.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge (per side)
instructions: Lie on your back, one foot flat, other leg straight up.
Press through the heel to lift the hips level.
Lower slowly; finish a side, then switch.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Full Back Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, hands by the ears, feet flat.
Press up so arms and legs straighten and the back arches evenly.
Hold, breathing steadily; lower slowly.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Needs shoulder and spine mobility; stop on any pinching.

variations.name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor.
Lift shoulders and straight legs a few centimetres, arms by the ears or sides.
Hold; make it easier by bending the knees.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: L-Sit (floor)
instructions: Sit with straight legs, hands beside the hips.
Press down, lift the hips and legs off the floor.
Hold with legs straight and locked.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: V-Sit (floor)
instructions: From an L-sit, lift the legs higher while leaning back slightly.
Keep the arms straight and the legs locked.
Hold; come down with control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Lying Leg Raise
instructions: Lie flat, lower back pressed down, legs straight.
Raise legs to vertical, lower slowly without arching.
Keep the movement slow.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: V-Up
instructions: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift legs and torso together, reaching hands toward the toes.
Lower slowly; keep control.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.

variations.name: Tuck Front Lever
instructions: Hang from a bar, pull the shoulders down and back.
Tuck the knees, raise the hips until the back is horizontal.
Hold with straight arms.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard skill: stop on any elbow or shoulder pain; consider coaching.

variations.name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
instructions: As the tuck lever, but open the hips so the thighs are about 90 degrees from the torso.
Keep the back flat and horizontal.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard skill: stop on any elbow or shoulder pain.

variations.name: Straddle Front Lever
instructions: Straddle the legs wide with the body horizontal.
Arms straight, shoulders depressed.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Hard skill: stop on any elbow or shoulder pain.

variations.name: Planche Lean
instructions: Push-up position, fingers turned slightly out.
Lean the shoulders forward past the hands, arms straight.
Hold with a rounded upper back and tight body.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Wrist-heavy: warm up the wrists, stop on wrist pain.

variations.name: Tuck Planche
instructions: From the lean, lift the feet with knees tucked to the chest.
Arms straight, hips level with the shoulders.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Wrist-heavy: stop on wrist pain.

variations.name: Advanced Tuck Planche
instructions: Open the hips so the back is flat and horizontal.
Arms straight, shoulders forward.
Hold.
cautions: Stop the set on sharp or joint pain; do not push through it.
Wrist-heavy: stop on wrist pain.

skillNodes.name: Push-up strength
skillNodes.description: From wall/incline or knees to a full push-up.

skillNodes.name: Straight-body core
skillNodes.description: Plank family foundation for later lever work.

skillEdges.criterion: A solid plank supports clean pulling.
